## EnforceCallOptions.writer property

Optional audit writer. When supplied, every enforcement decision is appended to it immediately. When omitted, the decision is returned but not persisted — useful for testing without I/O.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly writer?: AuditWriter | undefined;
```
